unresolved.reason: No current Tunisian or Equatorial Guinean primary source directly maps an ordinary Tunisian passport to a waiver, visa requirement or definite issuance route. The live eVisa text permits applications by all nationalities, not who needs a visa or lacks a waiver; it also directs approval-letter holders to seek a border stamp. No current operative ordinary-passport bilateral text was recovered.
